a.lede: The Fathom pickup won’t need a wall-mounted inverter to output 10 kW to your house.
a.title: Ford simplifies using your EV as a home battery with the $30K Fathom

b.lede: Ford is rolling out two new chargers capable of powering a home or the grid — so-called V2X capability.
b.title: Ford Fathom will be the cheapest American EV capable of powering a house
